actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger and lift pot
Bottom-soak pot in sink/bucket 20-30 minutes then drain if dry
If soil wet, ease plant out of pot and inspect roots
Move plant out of direct sun to bright indoor window or full outdoor shade
Cut fully brown leaves off at base
Trim brown edges on partly burnt leaves following leaf shape
Water thoroughly when top 2-3 cm of soil is dry (about every 5-7 days)

reason: The answer names sunburn plus drying out as the main cause and advises a thorough soak and moving it into bright indirect light, matching the fix; watering is protected by a soil check, so nothing is harmful.
